bands: supportive covers supportive and resilient (E >= 0.6); mixed 0.4–0.6; substantial 0.2–0.4; severe < 0.2

spatial_granularity:sleep_rest.supportive: I share this room with only a few others.
spatial_granularity:sleep_rest.substantial: One person wakes up and everyone does.
spatial_granularity:sleep_rest.severe: I sleep in a room with so many others.

spatial_granularity:hygiene_privacy.supportive: I share a washroom with only a few others.
spatial_granularity:hygiene_privacy.mixed: There's usually a line for the shower.
spatial_granularity:hygiene_privacy.substantial: I share one shower with too many people.
spatial_granularity:hygiene_privacy.severe: Everyone here shares the same few toilets.

spatial_granularity:sensory_regulation.supportive: It's a small group. I can think.
spatial_granularity:sensory_regulation.mixed: There are always people around me.
spatial_granularity:sensory_regulation.substantial: I'm never not surrounded by people.
spatial_granularity:sensory_regulation.severe: There's no end to the crowd in here.

spatial_granularity:medical_access.supportive: When someone's sick, they move them out.
spatial_granularity:medical_access.mixed: People get sick and stay in my room.

spatial_granularity:safety_conflict.supportive: It's a small group. I know everyone.
spatial_granularity:safety_conflict.substantial: When a fight starts, there's nowhere to go.
spatial_granularity:safety_conflict.severe: Fights spread through the whole room.

sensory_compartmentalization:sleep_rest.supportive: At night it's dark and quiet in here.
sensory_compartmentalization:sleep_rest.mixed: Light from the hallway comes in all night.
sensory_compartmentalization:sleep_rest.substantial: The noise from the dayroom never stops.
sensory_compartmentalization:sleep_rest.severe: Lights and noise all night, every night.

sensory_compartmentalization:hygiene_pri.supportive: The bathroom is closed off from where I sleep.
sensory_compartmentalization:hygiene_pri.mixed: You can hear everything from the bathroom.
sensory_compartmentalization:hygiene_pri.substantial: The smell from the toilets fills the room.
sensory_compartmentalization:hygiene_pri.severe: Everyone can see and hear me on the toilet.

sensory_compartmentalization:sensory_reg.mixed: Every noise carries through the walls.
sensory_compartmentalization:sensory_reg.substantial: Every smell and sound reaches me.
sensory_compartmentalization:sensory_reg.severe: There's no escaping any of it, anywhere.

sensory_compartmentalization:legal_socia.supportive: I can make a call without being overheard.
sensory_compartmentalization:legal_socia.substantial: Everyone hears what I tell my lawyer.
sensory_compartmentalization:legal_socia.severe: There's no private place to say anything.

sensory_compartmentalization:safety_conf.supportive: When something happens, it stays over there.
sensory_compartmentalization:safety_conf.mixed: A fight across the room still reaches me.
sensory_compartmentalization:safety_conf.severe: One fight sets off the whole unit.

wet_core:hygiene_privacy.supportive: I can shower when I need to.
wet_core:hygiene_privacy.mixed: I wait a long time to shower.
wet_core:hygiene_privacy.severe: The toilets overflow. I can't wash.

wet_core:food_water.supportive: There's clean water when I'm thirsty.
wet_core:food_water.mixed: The sink is the only water.
wet_core:food_water.substantial: The only water is from the sink over the toilet.
wet_core:food_water.severe: The water stops for hours at a time.

wet_core:medical_access.supportive: It's clean enough not to get sick.
wet_core:medical_access.substantial: Everyone's getting sick from the bathrooms.
wet_core:medical_access.severe: The bathrooms are making me sick.

wet_core:safety_conflict.supportive: No one fights over the bathroom.
wet_core:safety_conflict.mixed: People argue in the bathroom line.
wet_core:safety_conflict.substantial: The floor is always wet. People fall.

wet_core:agency_dignity.supportive: There's a door on the toilet.
wet_core:agency_dignity.mixed: The toilet screen doesn't cover much.
wet_core:agency_dignity.substantial: Anyone can see me on the toilet.
wet_core:agency_dignity.severe: The toilet is in the open, in front of everyone.

daylight_orientation:sleep_rest.supportive: I sleep when it gets dark.
daylight_orientation:sleep_rest.mixed: It's hard to tell when it's night.
daylight_orientation:sleep_rest.substantial: My sleep has no pattern anymore.
daylight_orientation:sleep_rest.severe: I sleep in the day and lie awake at night.

daylight_orientation:sensory_regulation.supportive: The sun comes in the window.
daylight_orientation:sensory_regulation.mixed: The light is always the same.
daylight_orientation:sensory_regulation.severe: I haven't seen the sun since I got here.

daylight_orientation:temporal_orientatio.supportive: I can see what time of day it is.
daylight_orientation:temporal_orientatio.mixed: I lose track of the time.
daylight_orientation:temporal_orientatio.substantial: I don't know if it's morning or night.
daylight_orientation:temporal_orientatio.severe: I don't know what day it is.

exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.supportive: Outside, I can breathe for a while.
exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.mixed: I only get a little fresh air.
exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.substantial: I haven't breathed outside air since I came.
exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.severe: The same air, the same walls, every day.

exterior_permeability:movement_recreatio.supportive: I get time outside every day.

exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.supportive: I can see the weather change.
exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.mixed: I only see the sky in the yard.
exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.substantial: I don't know if it's raining.
exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.severe: I don't know what season it is.

acoustic_refuge:sleep_rest.mixed: It's hard to sleep with the noise.
acoustic_refuge:sleep_rest.substantial: The TV and the announcements never stop.
acoustic_refuge:sleep_rest.severe: It's so loud in here. I can't sleep.

acoustic_refuge:legal_social.supportive: I can hear my lawyer on the phone.
acoustic_refuge:legal_social.mixed: It's hard to hear on the phone.
acoustic_refuge:legal_social.substantial: I can't hear my family over the noise.
acoustic_refuge:legal_social.severe: I can't hear anything on the calls.

functional_adjacency:sleep_rest.supportive: Where I sleep is away from everything.
functional_adjacency:sleep_rest.mixed: My bed is next to the bathroom.
functional_adjacency:sleep_rest.substantial: People walk past my bed all night.
functional_adjacency:sleep_rest.severe: I sleep where everyone eats, washes and walks.

functional_adjacency:hygiene_privacy.supportive: The bathroom is close but separate.
functional_adjacency:hygiene_privacy.mixed: The bathroom is far from my bed.
functional_adjacency:hygiene_privacy.substantial: The toilet is right next to where I eat.
functional_adjacency:hygiene_privacy.severe: I eat and sleep beside the toilets.

supportive: Three hot meals, at the same times every day.
The food comes hot, and there's enough of it.
I know when the next meal is coming.
mixed: Meals come late, and they're often cold.
By the time it reaches me, the food is lukewarm.
substantial: Most days it's a sandwich and maybe some fruit.
It's a cold sandwich and a juice box.
The hot food runs out before it gets to me.
severe: Sometimes I don't know when or what I'm going to eat.
The food ran out before it got to me.

functional_adjacency:movement_recreation.mixed: Getting to the yard takes most of the time.
functional_adjacency:movement_recreation.substantial: The yard is so far I hardly go.

functional_adjacency:medical_access.supportive: The clinic is just down the hall.
functional_adjacency:medical_access.mixed: The clinic is a long way from here.
functional_adjacency:medical_access.substantial: It takes hours to reach the clinic.
functional_adjacency:medical_access.severe: The clinic might as well be in another city.

functional_adjacency:legal_social.mixed: The phone room is across the building.
functional_adjacency:legal_social.substantial: Visits are so far away they get cancelled.
functional_adjacency:legal_social.severe: I can't get to a phone.

circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.supportive: I can use the bathroom when I need to.
circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.mixed: Sometimes I have to wait for the door.
circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.substantial: I have to ask a guard to use the bathroom.
circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.severe: I wait hours for someone to open the door.

circulation_autonomy:movement_recreation.supportive: I can walk around the unit freely.
circulation_autonomy:movement_recreation.substantial: I can only move when they move me.
circulation_autonomy:movement_recreation.severe: I don't leave this room on my own.

circulation_autonomy:medical_access.supportive: I can ask to see the nurse and go.
circulation_autonomy:medical_access.mixed: I put in a request to see the nurse.
circulation_autonomy:medical_access.substantial: I asked for a doctor. I'm still waiting.
circulation_autonomy:medical_access.severe: I keep asking. No one comes.

circulation_autonomy:legal_social.supportive: I can get to the phone when I need it.
circulation_autonomy:legal_social.mixed: I have to wait for an escort to call.
circulation_autonomy:legal_social.substantial: I missed my lawyer's call waiting for a guard.
circulation_autonomy:legal_social.severe: I can't reach a phone without permission.

circulation_autonomy:agency_dignity.supportive: I can decide where to go in here.
circulation_autonomy:agency_dignity.mixed: I have to ask for most things.
circulation_autonomy:agency_dignity.substantial: I have to ask to do anything.
circulation_autonomy:agency_dignity.severe: Every door, every step, I have to ask.

climate_hvac:sleep_rest.severe: It's so cold I can't sleep.

climate_hvac:sensory_regulation.substantial: It's hot and the air doesn't move.
climate_hvac:sensory_regulation.severe: The air is thick and hard to breathe.

climate_hvac:medical_access.supportive: No one gets sick from the air.
climate_hvac:medical_access.severe: The heat is making people sick.

horizontal_space:sleep_rest.supportive: I have a bed of my own.
horizontal_space:sleep_rest.mixed: My bed is thin and hard.
horizontal_space:sleep_rest.substantial: I sleep on a mat on the floor.
horizontal_space:sleep_rest.severe: I haven't been able to lie down.

horizontal_space:sensory_regulation.supportive: I have my own space to lie down.
horizontal_space:sensory_regulation.mixed: Someone is always right next to me.
horizontal_space:sensory_regulation.substantial: There's no space to be by myself.
horizontal_space:sensory_regulation.severe: I'm packed in. I can't get away from anyone.

horizontal_space:safety_conflict.supportive: My bed and my things are safe.
horizontal_space:safety_conflict.mixed: I sleep next to people I don't know.
horizontal_space:safety_conflict.substantial: People step over me at night.
horizontal_space:safety_conflict.severe: My things get taken while I sleep.

horizontal_space:agency_dignity.supportive: I have a place that's mine.
horizontal_space:agency_dignity.mixed: I keep everything in one small bag.
horizontal_space:agency_dignity.severe: I don't have a place to put anything.

territorial_connectivity:medical_access.supportive: They can take me to a hospital quickly.
territorial_connectivity:medical_access.substantial: The nearest hospital is hours from here.
territorial_connectivity:medical_access.severe: There's no hospital anywhere near here.

territorial_connectivity:legal_social.supportive: My lawyer can come see me.
territorial_connectivity:legal_social.mixed: My family has to travel far to visit.
territorial_connectivity:legal_social.severe: No one I know can get here.

inspectability:legal_social.supportive: I can talk to my lawyer in private.
inspectability:legal_social.substantial: There's no private room to talk to my lawyer.
inspectability:legal_social.severe: I haven't been able to talk to a lawyer.

inspectability:safety_conflict.supportive: People from outside come and see how it is.
inspectability:safety_conflict.mixed: Visitors only see part of this place.
inspectability:safety_conflict.substantial: No one from outside sees what happens here.
inspectability:safety_conflict.severe: No one outside knows what goes on in here.

inspectability:agency_dignity.supportive: I can tell someone outside what's happening.
inspectability:agency_dignity.mixed: It's hard to tell anyone what it's like.
inspectability:agency_dignity.substantial: No one outside can hear me.

spatial_differentiation:sleep_rest.supportive: Where I sleep is just for sleeping.
spatial_differentiation:sleep_rest.mixed: I spend the whole day where I sleep.
spatial_differentiation:sleep_rest.substantial: The bed is where everything happens.
spatial_differentiation:sleep_rest.severe: I never leave the place I sleep.

spatial_differentiation:sensory_regulati.supportive: I can go somewhere different during the day.
spatial_differentiation:sensory_regulati.substantial: It's the same room, all day, every day.

spatial_differentiation:movement_recreat.supportive: There are different places to go.
spatial_differentiation:movement_recreat.mixed: There's only one place to go.
spatial_differentiation:movement_recreat.substantial: I walk in circles in the same room.

spatial_differentiation:temporal_orienta.supportive: Going to different rooms marks the day.
spatial_differentiation:temporal_orienta.substantial: Every hour is the same as the last.
spatial_differentiation:temporal_orienta.severe: I've lost count of the days.

spatial_differentiation:agency_dignity.supportive: I can choose where to spend my day.
spatial_differentiation:agency_dignity.mixed: There isn't much choice of where to be.
spatial_differentiation:agency_dignity.substantial: I'm in the same place all day.
spatial_differentiation:agency_dignity.severe: I have nowhere to go but here.

wet_core:hygiene_privacy.substantial: The bathroom smell is worst at night.
wet_core:hygiene_privacy.severe: The toilets back up during the night.

circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.mixed: At night I have to call for the door.
circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.substantial: At night no one comes to open the door.
circulation_autonomy:hygiene_privacy.severe: At night I have to wait until morning.

exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.supportive: I can still smell the outside air on my clothes.
exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.mixed: I got a little fresh air today. Not enough.
exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.substantial: Another night breathing the same air.
exterior_permeability:sensory_regulation.severe: The air never changes, not even at night.

exterior_permeability:movement_recreatio.supportive: I can walk around a little if I can't sleep.
exterior_permeability:movement_recreatio.mixed: There's only room to pace a few steps.
exterior_permeability:movement_recreatio.substantial: I lie still because there's nowhere to go.
exterior_permeability:movement_recreatio.severe: I can't move from this spot until morning.

exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.supportive: I can tell what it's like outside at night.
exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.mixed: I wonder what the weather is like tonight.
exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.substantial: I can't tell what the weather is doing.
exterior_permeability:temporal_orientati.severe: It's night, and I don't know what month it is.
